english: Huh?\nI definitely heard Aria-san's voice from over here...
What are you mumbling to yourself about?\nWeird guy.
Whoa!? When did you get behind me!?
Getting behind a wide-open guy like you?\nEven a monkey could do it.
No, I don't think there's anyone among us\nwhose back you couldn't take...
And there's nobody whose back you can't take, either.
That's not what I came to talk about!\nHere, hold both hands out in front.
Huh? Okay.
You're under arrest on suspicion of theft.\nIf I'd caught you red-handed it'd be instant holes,\nbut I'll arrest you properly for now.
H-handcuffs!? I didn't steal anything!
Shut up!\nYou're the one who stole\nmy momo-man!
Momo-man? And why do you think it's me...
Your everyday suspicious behavior\nis the biggest reason to suspect you!
Well, even if you say that, I've always been like this...
That's it! That attitude is the problem!\nStraighten up!
If you're under false suspicion,\nyou'd normally act more dignified!
(I feel like she's saying something really unreasonable...)
Then at least hear me out!
That's right, but it wasn't me!
Oh, I expected you to be more timid.\nSurprising.\n...Cheeky for a slave apprentice!
At least let me talk!
Fine.\nI'll hear you out as an interrogation,\njust the talking!
But if you make even one suspicious move,\nit's instant holes! Got it!?
Y-yes...\nThen let me ask: what evidence is there that I'm the culprit...?
None!
Wh-what... seriously...
Even I, who's bad at deduction,\ncan tell by instinct!\nThe culprit is you! No doubt!
There's no other kid who'd steal\nmy momo-man,\nso obviously I suspect you!
I wouldn't steal someone else's things...
Then you're saying someone else stole it!?
Or are you saying I'm imagining the theft,\ncalling me an idiot!?
I'm not saying that!?\nI just think, for the future,\nwe should investigate properly...
...True, we absolutely\nneed to catch the culprit.
You lure me in like that, but actually\nYOU'RE the culprit, aren't you!!
Don't tell me you're planning to run away\nwhile I'm busy investigating...
I'm not!
Anyone can say that!\n...Fine. As surveillance too,\nI'll specially team up with you to investigate.
That's better than getting shot without questions...
(I've gotten dragged into something weird...\nIf we don't find the culprit, I might really get arrested...)
Slow!\nI thought you'd run off!
Next time you're late, I'll treat it as fleeing\ncustody and arrest you on the spot!\nGot it?
I-I'll be careful...
So, how did the canvassing go?
I didn't say 'momo-man'; I asked if they'd eaten\nanything sweet or tasty.
Oh, that's sharp for you.\nSeems your brain works a little.
So, anyone suspicious?
No. Zero.
So by process of elimination, that makes\nyou the culprit after all!
(That's unreasonable...)
I'm inspecting your belongings!\nEmpty your pockets and everything you're carrying\nright here!
Understood...
Good, so obedient! I might even go easy\non, say, your pinky cuticle.
(That assumes I'm getting arrested...)
Huh? Why would I...
Stop mumbling and show me!\nIf you've got nothing to hide, it's fine!
...Is this okay?
...That's all your belongings?\nYou're not hiding something somewhere?
I'm not hiding anything...
Hya!
Whoa! Handcuffs on my legs too!?\nWhat are you planning to do!
I'm doing a body search to see if you're hiding something!
This is a reasonable measure so you can't run,\nand so you can't commit any\np-perverted acts!
If you do anything weird,\nyou know what happens...!?
Y-yes... I don't want to die...
D-don't move!
Heave-ho... nothing in\nyour jacket pockets...
Next, the pants...
Y-you absolutely do not move!\nIf you move even a millimeter, I'll put holes in you!\nGot it!
(By the way, why has she been\nred this whole time...)
Seriously... why am I\ndoing this...
...Nothing here.
So my name is cleared, right?
...Evidence is insufficient, so unwillingly\nI have no choice but to release you temporarily.
(Temporarily... so she still suspects me...)
Showing up on your own like that,\nyou've got guts!
Or are you here to turn yourself in?\nToo bad, I don't accept those!
Handcuffs again!? I'm not turning myself in... what, suddenly?
Hmph, playing dumb!\nThat's pointless, obviously!
If you'd confessed honestly, I might have gone\na little easy on you!\nToo bad!
(This is getting out of hand...)
Now, spill it!\nWhat did you do with my momo-man!?
Again!? How many times—it's not me!
I've got the goods on you!\nQuietly tell me where\nthe momo-man is!
I'm telling you, it's not me...\nWhat goods, anyway...!
Of course, my intuition!\nObviously!
...So you're still denying it?\nFine, I'll have to interrogate it\nout of you!
Lately you've been picking\nfights with me to probe\nthe victim...
And you were enjoying watching\nme panic, weren't you!?\nYou pervert!
A two-time theft offender,\nand a pervert to boot!
(That's a terrible thing to say...\nIt's escalating...)
...Staying silent?\nYou have no right to silence!\nEven if the government allows it, I don't!
It's really not me...
I'm sick of your excuses.\n...You won't admit guilt?
N-no, I mean...
Then it's the last resort!\nChoose: my hands, or settle it\nyourself like a man!
I don't really get it, but I'll do it myself...
Good resolve!
Huh? Why would I...
Stop mumbling and show me!\nIf you've got nothing to hide, it's fine!
In the end it was just a belongings check.\nYou said 'last resort', so I wondered what you'd do...
No physical evidence... that's strange.\nI have no suspects but you.
Um, please take the handcuffs off already.\nThen I'll tell you my theory...
...Fine.
So, what's your theory?
This time it happened while the great Aria-san\nwas investigating, so it'd take a really skilled\nperson to pull it off.
True, I was on guard, but\nI didn't notice a thing.
Or...
The culprit might not realize it's theft?\nThen they wouldn't act suspicious,\nand even you might not notice...
That's impossible!\nThink properly before you speak!
(I got scolded...\nI thought about it seriously, though...)
What do you want? Oh, are you finally\nready to confess?
N-no, I'm not...!
Don't tell me you're going to claim\nto prove your innocence!
And then, pretending to corner the culprit,\nlure me to a cliff and then...
The first half is right, but\nthe second half is a bit too much...
Just kidding. I know you don't have\nthe guts for that.
(Harsh...)
So, do you have a lead on the culprit?
No, none at all...\nBut I have a good idea.
A good idea? What kind?
So we put a plate of momo-man on the ground,\nthen what?
We hide in the shadows and wait.\nThe smell will lure the culprit out...
It's not a monster;\nnobody'd fall for a trap like that.\nAre you serious?
Now now, just watch.
...See, nobody's coming.
That's weird... it should've...\nNo, wait a little longer...
...Just a little? If it fails,\nI'm arresting you.
Ah, enough! Stop, stop!\nNo culprit's coming with a method like this!
So, this momo-man,\nI'm having it! Okay!?
Nom! Mm! Delish!
Aria-san...
Wh-what's with that look!?\nIt can't be helped!\nIt looked delicious!
And after that long stakeout,\nmy stomach was empty!
You're too greedy for a noble...\nI heard you're from a prestigious family...
Shut up! A perfectly good momo-man,\nwe can't let it go bad!\nWhat a waste that'd be!
...Eat slowly.\nIf you rush, you'll choke...
Th-thanks... you're oddly obedient.\nWhich is good.
(Some time has passed since I bought it,\nso better than letting the momo-man spoil.\nAria-san looks happy, too.)
Given your obsession with momo-man,\nI can't picture any culprit but you...
Huh!? What are you saying!?
Aha! I get it!\nYou came up with this weird trap\nto frame me!
So you're the culprit!
That makes no sense...
Or were you planning to disrupt\nthe investigation from the start!?
N-no, that wasn't my intent...
Maybe I should turn you in to the police\nfor obstruction...!?
...I've been waiting for you.
D-don't tell me... another momo-man thief appeared...?
N-no, that's not it...\nUm... well...
Ugh, just figure it out!\nYou ultra-dense slave apprentice!
(What am I supposed to do with that...)
...I figured out who stole the momo-man!
I-it's not me...!
I know!\nThe culprit was the yo-yo girl...
She found some lovely monster and\nused my momo-man to feed it, apparently...
I know!\nThe culprit was the magician girl...
She used it as a practice prop for her\nteleportation magic, and it vanished when she failed...
And she forgot to buy more\nto replace it later...
She just handed me a momo-man\nshe bought...
That's good. So there was no thief after all.
It was a hasty misunderstanding.
Yes, it was!\nIt was my hasty misunderstanding!
Ugh... I can't believe I did that...
Anyway, case closed.\nGood...
It's not good! Misunderstanding and\nsuspecting an innocent person...
...I-I'm sorry.
Huh?
I'm sorry for suspecting you...\nI mean... sorry...
And if you hadn't been here,\nI might've caused trouble for everyone...
Raising a fuss that there's a momo-man thief here,\nwhen we'd finally gotten\nalong...
So, just a little... I'm grateful.
...Thank you.
No, not at all...
But don't get cocky!\nIt's not like the case got solved\nbecause of you!
I know.
Hmph!
(Case closed. I won't be chased around anymore.\nWhat a relief...)
Perfect timing!\nI was just looking for you.
Eep! Sorry,\nI'm not the culprit!
I know that!\nNothing's even happened.
Seriously, stop dragging it out.\nI already said I was sorry before.
It was reflex...\nSo, what do you need?
...An apology gift.
I couldn't hear you.\nWhat did you say?
What, you weren't listening?\nDon't make me say it over and over!
Ugh, an apology gift, an apology gift!\nI'm not saying it again!
Oh, an apology gift. That's fine.\nI'm not that bothered.
Just take it.\nOtherwise I won't feel right.
An apology gift? That's fine, really.
What! Let me give you an apology gift!\nI'd look bad otherwise!
Seriously, you're so inconsiderate...
If that's the case...\nSo, what is this apology gift?
Here, this. There's only one,\nso don't lose it, okay?
What's this? It says 'School Festival Invitation Ticket'.
Well, 'school festival' is\nactually kind of an exaggerated name.\nWe're not doing anything big.
We're all different ages, but\nmost of us are students, right?
So it's a get-together, in the name of\ndeepening bonds like students would.
Just bringing tea and sweets,\neating and chatting, that level.
With all the incidents happening,\nwe can't afford to relax\ntoo much, right?
...I haven't heard anything about this.
You realize, right?\nYou're kind of a troublemaker?
So we decided to tell you\non the day, so you wouldn't get in the way of prep.
So I'm a troublemaker...
You didn't realize?\n...You're really dense.
Leave me alone...\nBy the way, why are you giving me the invitation?
W-well, that's...
You're... one of us, sort of...
And thanks to you, we didn't end up\nsuspecting everyone weirdly...\nThat's something.
A-anyway! You don't have to help with prep, but\nsince I invited you,\nyou absolutely have to come!
(A school festival...\nI don't really get it, but it sounds fun...!)
Um, put these two pieces of fabric together...
Aria-san, what are you doing?
Eep! Don't scare me!\nI'm doing work that needs concentration!
(She's sewing something.\nA costume for the school festival?)
What are you doing?
Can't you tell by looking? Prepping.\nSchool festival prep.
You can sew?
It's a skill I use for work, so of course.\nWell, I'm not particularly good at it.
Butei Charter, Article 7.\n'Prepare with pessimism, act with optimism'!
For example, if your bulletproof uniform gets damaged,\nand you're in enemy territory, you're helpless\nif you can't fix it yourself, right?
I see...
Is there anything I can do?
Fufu. You're exempt from prep, so\njust relax.
I'll take the thought.\n...I'd be in trouble if you caused something.
Actually, can I watch?
I don't mind, but why?
I'm a little curious...\nI want to know what you're doing.
O-okay. You can watch, but\nbe quiet, okay?\nIt takes a lot of concentration.
Yes, I'll be careful.
This fabric is the front and this is... huh?\nWhich one's the front...
Your finger's bleeding... Heal.
Th-thanks...
...Let me help too.\nDoing nothing while everyone works\nfeels wrong...
Fufu, good attitude. Fine,\nmy finger still kind of hurts, so\nI'll specially allow it!
But don't mess up?\nThread aside, this is\nthe only fabric we have.
I'll be careful...\nWell then...!
You stabbed your own finger right away.\nFufu, you're surprisingly clumsy.
That was just bad luck...
Fufu. Seriously, you're hopeless.
(I feel kind of frustrated...\nBut if it made her laugh, that's fine.)
(At first, I thought she'd never\nsmile at me...)
It's really lively...\nRight, I came to the 'school festival'\nAria-san mentioned...
I heard it wasn't a big deal, but this is pretty elaborate...
Ah, there's a sign.\n'Cosplay Café SHC'.\nI'll go in for now...
W-welcome home, b-big brother!\n...Don't laugh! I know it's not like me!
A-Aria-san? Or rather, Aria-chan?\nWhat is that outfit!?
Wh-what! You're gonna laugh too!?\nThe rule is you wear whatever you draw,\nso it can't be helped...!
N-no, not at all...!
(But... it suits her terrifyingly well.\nThough saying that would get me holes, probably.)
Don't go quiet on me...\nThat just makes it more embarrassing...!
Ugh! Your order! Decide quickly!
H-huh? Then, I don't really know, so I'll leave it to you.
Got it, wait a moment.
Here's your cake and tea set!
This cake, could it be...
Y-yes! Homemade cake!
...Sorry the shape's all lopsided!
No, not at all.\nAnd, nom... it's really delicious.
Delicious? R-really, good...!
(Huh? Why does it taste good?\nI thought I couldn't really taste things...)
What, that stunned look!\nOf course I'm happy to be praised!\nIt's not because YOU said it!?
Aria-saaaan!\n...Huh! Where am I...?\nI was at the café just now...
Ah, there you are. What were you doing\nover there?
Huh? Aria-san, why the uniform?
Why? I've been in uniform the whole time.\nYou overslept and you're groggy, aren't you?
Seriously. I went out of my way to give you an invitation,\nwhat were you doing?
But... just now,\ncosplay Aria-san served me cake and tea...
...Were you really asleep?\nThe school festival ended ages ago?
In the end, since you never came,\nI came looking for you.
N-no way...
Yes yes, don't make that face.\nThey're just leftover cookies, but\nI brought them for you.
Th-thank you...
(Ugh... what a shock...)
